mapper.sql: video.id as video_id, video.video_name as video_name, video.video_name_index as video_name_index, video.video_desc as video_desc, video.file_id as video_file_id, video.sub_id as video_sub_id, video.source_url as video_source_url, video.video_source as video_source, video.order as video_order, video.update_time as video_update_time, video.create_time as video_create_time, video.thumbnail_url as video_thumbnail_url, video.video_time as video_time, video.origin_course_id as video_origin_course_id

video_file.id as video_file_id, video_file.name as video_file_name, video_file.file_url as video_file_url, video_file.save_type as video_file_save_type, video_file.video_long as video_file_video_long, video_file.file_type_index as video_file_type_index, video_file.thumb_nail_url as video_file_thumb_nail_url, video_file.thumb_nail_id as video_file_thumb_nail_id, video_file.file_type as video_file_type, video_file.upload_uid as video_user_id

video_origin_course.id AS video_origin_course_id, video_origin_course.name AS video_origin_course_name, video_origin_course.fid AS video_origin_course_fid, video_origin_course.state AS video_origin_course_state, video_origin_course.available_type AS video_origin_course_available_type, video_origin_course.sub_img_id AS video_origin_course_img_id, video_origin_course.create_time AS video_origin_course_create_time, video_origin_course.update_time AS video_origin_course_update_time

course.id AS course_id, course.name AS course_name, course.fid AS course_fid, course.state AS course_state, course.available_type AS course_available_type, course.sub_img_id AS course_img_id, course.create_time AS course_create_time, course.update_time AS course_update_time

course_avatar.id AS video_origin_course_avatar_file_id, course_avatar.name AS video_origin_course_avatar_file_name, course_avatar.file_url AS video_origin_course_avatar_file_url, course_avatar.save_type AS video_origin_course_avatar_file_save_type, course_avatar.file_type AS video_origin_course_avatar_file_type

course_owner.id AS video_origin_course_user_id, course_owner_info.id AS video_origin_course_user_info_id, course_owner_info.first_name AS video_origin_course_user_info_first_name, course_owner_info.last_name AS video_origin_course_user_info_last_name

course_owner_avatar.id AS video_origin_course_user_info_avatar_file_id, course_owner_avatar.file_url AS video_origin_course_user_info_avatar_file_url, course_owner_avatar.save_type AS video_origin_course_user_info_avatar_file_save_type, course_owner_avatar.file_type AS video_origin_course_user_info_avatar_filetype
mapper.select:
SELECT course_content.id, course_content.course_id, course_content.content_id, course_content.order, , , (SELECT COUNT(id) FROM gc_video_comment WHERE video_id = video.id) AS video_comment_num, , , , ,
FROM course_content JOIN gc_subject course ON course_content.course_id = course.id
JOIN gc_video video ON course_content.content_id = video.id JOIN sys_file video_file ON video.file_id = video_file.id
JOIN gc_subject video_origin_course ON video.origin_course_id = video_origin_course.id JOIN gc_subject section ON course_content.course_id = section.id JOIN gc_user course_owner ON video_origin_course.create_user = course_owner.id LEFT JOIN sys_file course_avatar ON course_avatar.id = video_origin_course.sub_img_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info course_owner_info ON course_owner.info_id = course_owner_info.id LEFT JOIN sys_file course_owner_avatar ON course_owner_info.avatar_file_id = course_owner_avatar.id WHERE course_content.course_id = #{courseId} OR course_content.course_id IN (SELECT id FROM gc_subject WHERE fid = #{courseId}) ORDER BY section.order, course_content.order, course_content.content_id
